class_name: 起点-極端例-カラシテ類

provenance.pipeline: satsuki v1: author → mechanical attachment gate → cold review → fixes applied → gate re-run

glosses: if even the … is anything to go by
patterns.usage_note: Picks out the most basic or first-noticed detail and invites you to extrapolate: if even that much is so, the whole is. It attaches straight to a noun and the predicate is an evaluation — most often critical (看板[かんばん]からして怪[あや]しい) but equally admiring (食器[しょっき]からして違[ちが]う). Keep it distinct from the inferential からすると family: the same surface からして serves as their adverbial variant, but this pattern is exemplifying, not reasoning from evidence to a guess. からしまして is the polite form.

examples.ruby: あの店[みせ]は看板[かんばん]からして怪[あや]しい。
examples.english: That place looks dodgy starting with the sign out front.

examples.ruby: この映画[えいが]はタイトルからして意味[いみ]が分[わ]からない。
examples.english: With this film, even the title makes no sense, and it goes downhill from there.

examples.ruby: あの旅館[りょかん]は玄関[げんかん]の生[い]け花[ばな]からして違[ちが]う。
examples.english: That inn is on another level, starting with the flower arrangement in the entryway.
